title: Eddoboozi ery’amazima ery’Edda
intro: Waliwo emmeeme mu Quran ng’emboozi yaayo eyogerwa mu aya ntono zokka, naye ate engeri zaabwe ez’ekitiibwa ziyakaayakana n’obutangaavu obw’amaanyi. Atenderezebwa Omuyinza w’ebintu byonna olw’empisa ennungi ey’enjawulo, omuweereza ono ow’edda ow’Omusaasizi ennyo alina ekifo mu mpapula z’okubikkulirwa. Omulimu gwo kwe kuzuula omuwendo guno ogw’ekitalo. Osobola okuteebereza ani gwe bali?
clues: Ndi nnabbi wa Allah eyabeera mu milembe egy’obuntu egyasooka.
Allah yanjogerako mu kitabo kye ne bannabbi abalala, bonna nga batenderezebwa olw’empisa ennungi emu ey’ekitiibwa.
Nze njogerwako ng’omusajja ow’amazima mu Quran.
Allah yansitula ku siteegi eya waggulu abalala batono gye batuuseeko.
Erinnya lyange lyogerwako mu Surah Al-Anbiya, nga likuŋŋaanyiziddwa ne bannabbi abalala babiri abatenderezebwa olw’obugumiikiriza bwabwe.
Nze Idris, nnabbi ow’amazima era omugulumivu.

identity.label: Nze Ani?
options: Nabbi Idris
Nabbi Nuh
Nabbi Ibrahim
Nabbi Musa
Nabbi Ismail

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Okukuuma obugumiikiriza n’amazima, olwo n’asitulwa okutuuka ku siteegi eya waggulu
Okuzimba eryato ennene okutaasa abakkiriza okuva mu mataba agasaanyaawo
Okusuulibwa mu muliro ogwaka n’avaayo nga tofunye buzibu bwonna
Okusisinkana kabaka ow’amaanyi n’okuwangula eggye lye ery’abalogo
Okuwona munda mu lubuto lw’ekyennyanja ekinene mu buziba bw’ennyanja
trial.answer: Okukuuma obugumiikiriza n’amazima, olwo n’asitulwa okutuuka ku siteegi eya waggulu

location.label: Ekintu Ekikulu
options: Ekifo ekigulumivu era ekigulumivu Allah
Emmeeri ennene ennyo eyazimbibwa okuva mu bibaawo era ng’esimbiddwako kolaasi
Omuliro ogw’amaanyi ogwayokebwa abasinza ebifaananyi ba kabaka omubi
Ennyanja ennene ennyo eyayawukana mu makubo amakalu
Olubuto oluddugavu olw’ennyanja ekika kya whale ennene wansi mu nnyanja

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Yayingizibwa mu kusaasira kwa Allah ng’omu ku batuukirivu
Yalokoka wamu n’abakkiriza bonna okuva mu mataba mu nsi yonna
Yatambula okuva mu nnimi z’omuliro nga takwatibwako muliro
Yakulembera Abaana ba Isiraeri nga tebalina mirembe mu ddembe emitala w’ennyanja
Bazzeemu okukwatagana n’ab’omu maka gaabwe abaagala ennyo oluvannyuma lw’emyaka mingi egy’obuzibu
outcome.answer: Yayingizibwa mu kusaasira kwa Allah ng’omu ku batuukirivu

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
